name: Hidden Gem
controllingIdea: The best opportunities often hide in plain sight, waiting for those who know where to look.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A property that appears unremarkable at first glance
narrativeArc.risingAction: Revealing the unexpected features, potential, or value others missed
narrativeArc.crisis: Why everyone else overlooked it - and why that's their loss
narrativeArc.climax: The 'aha' moment of recognizing hidden value
narrativeArc.resolution: Smart buyer's reward - or invitation to be that smart buyer

triggerMoments.moment: Found a property with amazing bones but dated presentation
Underpriced property due to poor marketing
Great location overshadowed by cosmetic issues

triggerKeywords: don't let the photos fool you

questions.question: What's unremarkable about this property at first glance?
questions.placeholder: The listing photos are terrible and it's been on market 90 days...

questions.question: What did you discover that others missed?
questions.placeholder: The backyard has an unpermitted ADU that's nearly finished...

questions.question: Why do you think others overlooked it?
questions.placeholder: Everyone saw the dated kitchen and walked away before seeing the basement...

questions.question: What's the real value or opportunity here?
questions.placeholder: It's priced $80k below similar homes because of the cosmetic issues...

questions.question: Who should be paying attention to this?
questions.placeholder: Investor who can see past paint colors, or handy buyer who wants instant equity...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a discovery story about a property most people dismissed. Position the agent as the insider who sees what others don't. The tone should feel like sharing a secret.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Knowing, slightly conspiratorial, but backed by facts. You're letting people in on something others missed.

slideStructure.contentFocus: Act now before others catch on

usageHints: Best for properties with clear but overlooked value
Position yourself as the agent who sees deeper

exampleScenarios.title: 90 Days on Market Diamond
exampleScenarios.situation: Home with terrible photos sitting ignored but great location
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: This house has been on market 90 days with zero offers. The photos are dark and show clutter. But it's on a half-acre in the best school district, and it's priced $50k under comps. Just needs staging.

expectedOutput.hook: 90 days. Zero offers. Here's what everyone missed.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: $50k under comps. Half acre. Best school district.
